note: The apron outside the terminal (zone of R_airport), camera at the terminal's glass doors looking out to the grass runway and control tower. Only cabine is feminine (little plane with a cut-away cabin and the jelly-bean jar, far LEFT; divider pulled left). Masculine: jet with a V on its tail and its lights ON (avion), vole climbing the boarding stairs (vol), red helicopter with a waving bearded adult pilot (hélicoptère), old bearded pilot steering the yellow tug (pilotage), workman carrying away a giant spirit level (enlèvement), girl at the paper-plane collage (décollage), toy plane landed on the café terrace (atterrissage), parrot landed under its parachute (parachute), eagle soaring (essor). The terminal's glass doors at the far left lead back inside. Painted 2026-10-22.
